findings.text: the fragment and the manifest checkpoint assert that "against the listing arm the same test records ten" published rows, but no listing-arm log exists under the run's logs/ and no such arm exists in the test, so the guard's sensitivity is claimed rather than shown.

the release announcement is printed to stdout, which the watcher unit appends to watch_log_path (watch_unit.py:1007-1015), not to the transition stream watch_stream_path (run_paths.py:31-33) that ticker and follower readers consume, so the section's "announced once on the stream" reaches only a reader of the log file.

_ANNOUNCED_RELEASES dedupes an announcement that is always followed by sys.exit, so outside tests it never suppresses a second print while adding module-level mutable state that every test must reset.
